verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's documentation site serves a root llms.txt at docs.nvidia.com that collects llms.txt files "for AI user agents". Related stacks have their own llms.txt, including CUDA, which covers Blackwell kernel tuning, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs relevant to B300. However, there is no evidence of a DGX/B300-specific llms.txt, and the markdown version of the DGX B300 user guide returns 404. missing for 10: a B300/DGX-specific llms.txt or markdown docs, confirmation that the DGX B300 user guide is indexed in the root llms.txt, hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
